$comment: Single source of truth for the one finding tend-refactor reports per run. validate-finding.mjs reads this at runtime — do not duplicate these rules in prose. Unlike tend-security's finding-schema.json (one fixed shape), refactor covers three finding kinds (dead-code-removal, type-tightening, component-extraction) sharing one envelope; kind-specific rules beyond generic shape (e.g. 'component-extraction needs 2+ instances') are enforced in validate-finding.mjs as Layer 2 checks, the same way file-existence and line-range checks are, since this schema's interpreter has no conditional/if-then support.

kind.description: Which of the three scan-core.md sub-domains this finding belongs to.

title.description: Short human-readable name of the change, e.g. 'Consolidate duplicated slugify() into src/lib/utils/slug.ts'.

file.description: Primary file the finding targets, relative to repo root. For dead-code-removal and type-tightening, the file containing the fix. For component-extraction, the new component file. Must exist on disk.

line.description: 1-indexed primary line number — the fixed line for dead-code-removal/type-tightening, or the new component's first line for component-extraction. Must be within the file's actual line count.

evidence.description: Proof the fix is mechanical, matching this finding's kind: for dead-code-removal, grep evidence of the duplicated/deprecated pattern across 2+ call sites; for type-tightening, the existing type/interface reused and why the shape is unambiguous from context (no guessing); for component-extraction, confirmation that every listed instance (not a sample) was read and what varies vs. what's structurally identical. Not a restatement of the title.

fix.description: The minimal change applied, described specifically enough to verify against the diff.

verify.description: How a reviewer confirms the fix — a command to run (typecheck/lint/tests), or a page/flow to check for identical rendering.

instances.description: Required (2+ entries) when kind is 'component-extraction': every call site replaced by the new component. Omit for the other two kinds.

file.description: Path to a replaced call site, relative to repo root. Must exist on disk.

line.description: 1-indexed line of the replaced markup in this instance's file.
